# Task title

Status: ready

Goal: state the user-visible outcome.

Owner paths: list the files or modules this task owns. Identify shared contracts and paths owned by concurrent work.

Dependencies: name prerequisites and the commits or interfaces they provide.

Acceptance: list observable behavior, relevant failure cases, and evidence required. Use measured limits only when the product actually needs them.

Code map: cite current symbols, paths, and relevant tests. Include only the specification extracts needed for this task; verify against current code.

Approach: ordered implementation steps, relevant validation commands, and a natural checkpoint for substantial work.

Pitfalls: known constraints and references to consult if needed.

As built: record deviations, verified results, and information downstream tasks need when the task completes.
